subject: Interim billing: mid-cycle seat addition + VAT treatment
messages:

To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@novushealth.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-month add-on charge & VAT question

Hi Evelyn,

Quick question: we added 12 seats to our Dedicated pool on 2026-08-20. When I pulled our billing it looks like there was a partial charge for the additional seats on the invoice generated on 2026-08-21, but VAT is applied to the full monthly amount instead of the pro-rated portion. Can you confirm how Redwood is calculating VAT for mid-cycle seat changes? We need the correct taxable amount for our AP team to remit.

Also — if the charge was incorrect, can you issue a credit and reissue an adjusted invoice? We’re on a Net30 cadence but need the paperwork right for our internal tax team.

Thanks,
Rajiv

rajiv.menon@novushealth.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-month add-on charge & VAT question

Hi Rajiv — thanks for flagging this. Short answer: VAT should only be applied to the taxable portion of the mid-cycle charge (the pro-rated seat add-on), not the full monthly recurring value.

What likely happened: our billing system generated the provisional invoice with the correct pro-rated base amount but the tax calculation used the "monthly subscription" tax class for that invoice line, which caused VAT to be computed on the full month. Im sorry for the confusion — we do support pro-rata VAT for mid-cycle adjustments.

Next steps Im proposing:
- Ill loop in Finance (Monica + Ben) to validate the math and issue one of the following depending on the outcome:
  1) a corrected invoice with the pro-rated taxable amount and updated VAT line, or
  2) if payment has already been processed, a credit note for the over-collected VAT and a corrected invoice.
- Ive attached a draft proration worksheet and a provisional pro-rata invoice for your review (see attachments).
- Please confirm whether Novus is VAT-registered in the US (state sales tax may be different) or if you are operating under a EU/UK entity for this contract — that will determine the tax jurisdiction we apply.

Ill aim to have Finances recommendation by Monday COB.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
[Attachment: proration_calc_novus_08-28.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-month add-on charge & VAT question (internal)

Eve / Ben,

I reviewed the billing export and Rajiv is correct — invoice #INV-20260821-7831 shows a line for "Dedicated seats - Aug 2026" with a proration factor, but the tax algorithm incorrectly applied the monthly tax base. Quick summary below: 

- Effective seat add date: 2026-08-20 (pro-rated days: 12/31)
- Unit price per seat/month: $200
- Pro-rated charge: 12 seats * $200 * (12/31) = $9,290.32 (rounded)
- Invoice shows tax on $2,400*12 seats = $28,800 instead of the pro-rated $9,290.32 (tax delta = tax_rate * $19,509.68)

Recommendation: issue a credit note for the VAT over-collection and reissue corrected invoice INV-20260828-7831_PRORATA. Ive drafted a credit note and the corrected invoice PDF (attached). We should also record an accounting memo so AP can reconcile the two documents.

If Novus hasnt remitted tax yet, we can mark the original invoice as superseded; if they have remitted we need to coordinate a refund/offset. Ben, can you confirm if we should process a net-zero settlement or issue a cash refund by check/ACH?

Monica
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invoice_PRORATA_20260828.pdf (PDF), credit_note_draft_20260830.pdf (PDF), proration_calc_novus_08-28.xlsx (Excel)]

Hi all — copying Rajiv so Novus sees the resolution path.

Monica is correct. Finance will:
1) Void invoice INV-20260821-7831 in our billing system and flag it as "superseded".
2) Issue credit note CN-20260830-7831 for the over-collected VAT (see attached).
3) Publish corrected pro-rated invoice INV-20260828-7831_PRORATA (attached PDF) showing the pro-rated line and VAT calculated on the pro-rated amount.
4) Add an accounting memo and reference the HubSpot deal ID so AP has a reconciliation trail.

Rajiv: we will not ask you to pay twice. If you have already paid INV-20260821-7831, the credit will offset your next statement or we can issue an ACH refund — let me know the preferred route. If Novus prefers a credit memo applied to future invoices, we will link CN-20260830-7831 to your account.

Evelyn, please send Rajiv the corrected invoice + credit note PDFs and confirm if Novus is VAT-registered in the relevant jurisdiction (state-level sales tax vs VAT).
